profile.headline: HRIS Leader | Oracle HCM Cloud Security Engineer | Functional Risk, Controls and Security Solutions Architect | Motivational Speaker
profile.jobTitle: Workforce Technology | Software Engineer | Oracle HCM Cloud Security
profile.summary:
I am a versatile and highly analytical professional with 15+ years of experience in conceptualizing, developing, and owning Cloud Human Capital Management (HCM) and Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) solutions tailored to address intricate business challenges and drive process enhancements. I have steered daily operations, including workload balance, auditing, data processing, and staff training to uphold data integrity and timely service recovery. I am adept at adhering to project plans/deadlines and employing comprehensive knowledge of varied programs, interfaces, procedures, and dashboards. I have maintained documentation, complied with regulatory requests, and stayed current with HRIS/HCM trends. I have a comprehensive background in Oracle Fusion HCM, including design, testing, rollout, and implementation for global workforce management.

Fluent in English

Areas of Expertise:
HRIS/HCM Strategic Planning, Project Leadership, JIRA Ticket Management, Oracle HCM and Financials, Change Management, HCM Consultation Service, Team Structure Enhancement, Testing and Quality Assurance, Requirements Gathering and Analysis.

Industry Experience:
Truck Transportation, Financial Services, Construction, Food and Beverage Manufacturing, Hospitality, Individual and Family Services.

Feel free to reach out to me directly on LinkedIn or at dawilliams444@gmail.com.

Have a great day!

positions.title: Workforce Technology | Software Engineer | Oracle HCM Cloud Security
Human Resources | People Systems Manager
positions.description:
Spearheaded HR systems-related projects, with a focus on Oracle HCM Cloud, in a leadership role within the HR Department. Oversaw JIRA ticket assignments with weekly updates, addressed issue investigations, and managed enhancement requests for modules such as learning, talent, performance, compensation, benefits, Core HR, and recruiting with HR IT Product Owner, Business Process Leads, and Accenture Managed Services Team. Conducted thorough reviews of all JIRA tickets upon initial opening while determining optimal ticket ownership assignment (Accenture or Forward) based on considerations of priority, business impact, and resource capacity. Facilitated the equity and salary adjustments for direct reports post obtaining approval from the HR Director and Chief People Officer.

Saved $16K+ consultancy costs by overseeing the complete EEO-1 process transition, covering maintenance, updates, report generation, error-free submissions, and filing for legal entities within deadlines.

Collaborated actively with IT teams to architect and launch the OHFCM review board, overseeing Oracle change management, and instituting processes for weekly approval of Production changes.

Backed the application and stabilization of Oracle Cloud Financials through active support and involvement in related activities.

Revamped the HCM systems team structure by applying updates to job descriptions, refreshing outdated SOPs, and crafting 3 new SOPs.

positions.title: Workforce Technology | Sr. Lead Software Engineer | Oracle HCM Cloud Security Architect
Information Technology | Oracle HCM Cloud Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Navigated an IT role that merged the responsibilities and expertise of both a Business Analyst and Solution/Application Architect, engaging effectively at strategic and tactical levels for holistic solution development. Managed software support cases with SaaS vendors, including Oracle and Taleo, while delivering comprehensive reporting support, including ad-hoc reporting and data analysis, for HR, recruiting, and payroll functions, using BI reporting tools. Partnered with the vendor (Oracle) to lead routine SaaS system maintenance, offer system security support, and handle configuration setup and administration tasks for Oracle HCM and Taleo.

Investigated and deployed innovative solutions for complex issues across all severity levels by submitting both technical and non-technical SRs with Oracle Customer Support.

Improved overall system efficiency and responsiveness by constructing, configuring, and updating system workflows, alerts, notifications, and templates.

Steered the management of data, technical, and testing aspects for upgrade, implementation, integration, and migration projects.

Collaborated across IT and various business units, including finance, marketing, HR, operations, and executive management, delivering projects and documentation as per standardized methodologies 
developed for the Enterprise and Project Systems.

positions.title: Human Resources | Oracle HCM Senior Business Analyst
positions.description:
Oversaw configuration changes and testing for the Global Oracle HCM application, managing 40+ inbound/outbound interfaces across Canadian, UK, and US business units. Led the setup of personalization and played a key role in the testing phase to confirm a deployment across diverse geographical locations. Timely identified issues, derived solutions, executed test plans, and applied necessary changes with functional users and IT and 3rd party offshore development teams. Conducted gap analysis to assess the alignment of requirements with the existing application, determining areas for enhancement and presenting alternative solutions. Made strategic recommendations tailored to the business needs and aligned with the long-term application strategy.

Enhanced clarity and adherence to established implementation standards by maintaining functional design documentation in accordance with Oracle Applied Implementation Methodology (AIM) for Core HR, Oracle Advanced Benefits, Manager Self-Service, and Employee Self-Service.

Controlled the Canada OAB benefits initiative and monitored the implementation project for outsourcing benefits administration, which confirmed efficient processes.

Utilized Oracle SQL Developer for data management, system functionality, and maintenance of lookup tables, value sets, and fast formulas.

Validated business processes by conceptualizing and completing quality assurance and user acceptance testing procedures.

Coordinated with business users during UAT by guiding test script creation/execution and certifying approval of test results.

Administered the implementation of Oracle Cloud in international offices, including those in Chile, Morocco, Mexico, and Peru.
